stock.description: China Dongxiang (Group) Co., Ltd. is primarily involved in the design, development, marketing, and sale of sport-related apparel, footwear, and accessories. The company operates both domestically within the People's Republic of China and across international markets, offering its products under well-known brands such as Kappa and Phenix. Customers can purchase these items through a network of physical retail shops, outlets, and online platforms. Beyond its core sportswear business, China Dongxiang also diversifies its operations into various sectors, including managing investments in financial assets and treasury products issued by commercial banks, designing and selling children's clothing, offering hotel management and tourism services, and developing and operating real estate properties. As of March 31, 2022, the company maintained 1,375 Kappa retail locations. Established in 2002, China Dongxiang (Group) Co., Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Beijing, People's Republic of China.
